rootCause.requiredRefactor: Expose the already-computed canonical implementation base from the trusted delegated-governance authority result, then make the delegated-product L2 verifier consume that exact authority-provided base for its path/count/digest seal. Do not independently recompute another merge base in the L2 verifier.
